rationale: No candidate contains the child's distinctive reimbursement machinery: commuted transportation rates by zone and weight, separate temporary-storage rates, an actual-cost ceiling, and documentary support requirements. C15 and C01 are the closest only because they amend earlier executive orders, while C08 shares a terse regulatory style and effective-date framing; those similarities are generic and do not amount to a concrete, material drafting template.
